henry_eng: agree. i'll run the sanitizer and convert runnable PoCs into step-by-step repro notes. ETA: today EOD (2012349000).

henry_eng: sanitizer complete. replaced hostnames with <REDACTED_HOST>, removed tokens, converted binaries to pseudo-PoC markdown. uploaded sanitized bundle to s3://redwood-secure/atlas/2012345678/sanitized/ and updated manifest. audit id 2012349100.
legal_bot: audit: sanitized bundle published by henry_eng at 2012349100. link expiry 21 days. sha256: d4e5f6...

maria_sales: drafting email to ATLAS sec with sanitized artifacts, manifest, CVSS table and proposed SLA. do we include interim mitigations/runbook?
dan_se: include runbook and workaround flags (rate-limit toggle + auth patch guide). i'll attach the one-page RA template.
maria_sales: sending now. will cc kevin_ciso and henry_eng. if ATLAS requests raw PoCs without NDA, do not send and escalate to legal. :thumbsup:
